label: On RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_3 present-tense reception is accompaniment
paraphrase: Closed definitional result, attribution deferred: for every history, origin relation and reception predicate, when present-tense receipt is read relationally (relationalReceipt, RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_3: z receives x's esse at t iff x's esse is received in z, x is present at t, and x bears the origin relation at t to something), the present-tense reading of reception holds iff whatever has received esse bears the origin relation to something whenever it is present (accompaniment).
